title: Algerian-Style Indian Potato Tagine
description: A twist on traditional Indian cuisine, this recipe combines Algerian spices with the comforting flavors of a potato tagine.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add potatoes, spices, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Stir in tagine spice mix and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
